name: effect-fence-client-error-omitted-generation-400
description: A MALFORMED REQUEST IS NEVER A HOLD. expected_generation is OMITTED -- the client never captured the comparand -- and the answer is HTTP 400 naming that field, not a 200 hold. A hold invites a retry, and no number of identical retries supplies a value the caller does not have; if an incomplete request also answered 'hold', the fixable and the unfixable would be one answer on the wire. Pins the OMITTED/null asymmetry against 07, whose request differs only in carrying the key as an explicit null and which HOLDS. Also pins that the field is named DISTINCTLY -- 'missing expected_generation', not a generic 'missing field' -- so a caller can tell which one it forgot; 12 is the same contract for content_hash.
_comment: Single-key {error: <lowercase phrase>} envelope, the adapter-wide non-200 body shape and the CLI's parse contract. Same shape as warn_mode/06-pre-read-missing-session-id-400.json.
